## 用户目标

- clamp(value, lo, hi): value < lo 时返回 lo；value > hi 时返回 hi；否则返回 value。
- in_range(value, lo, hi): 当 lo <= value <= hi 时返回 True，否则返回 False。

"""Range helpers."""


def clamp(value, lo, hi):
    if value < lo:
        return lo
    if value > hi:
        return hi
    return value


def in_range(value, lo, hi) -> bool:
    return lo <= value <= hi

sha256: 83b606077748ca189453526e014cfb468eee97dfb958f0b5adabe069c4fe4764
```python
"""Slug helpers."""

import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug.

    Lowercases the input, replaces each run of non-alphanumeric
    characters (anything outside a-z, 0-9) with a single "-", and
    strips leading/trailing "-".
    """
    lowered = title.lower()
    replaced = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", lowered)
    return replaced.strip("-")

```
